query:
SELECT s.id as sponsorId, s.companyName, s.userId, i.id as intakeId, i.companyName as intakeCompanyName, i.submittedAt 
FROM sponsors s 
LEFT JOIN intakeSubmissions i ON s.id = i.sponsorId 
ORDER BY s.id DESC;
